when_used: A declarant sets out facts on oath in support of an application to the land registry, in the declarant's own words.

body_text.text: (in support of this Application) do hereby sincerely declare as follows:-
I make this declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true and according to the Oaths and Statutory Declaration Act.

execution.jurat_signatory: Signature of Commissioner for Oaths or Magistrate or Notary Public

custom_fields.name: declarant_name
custom_fields.label: Name of the declarant
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the person swearing this declaration in support of the application
